notes.title: Happy Lunar New Year! An official preview of Blade Souls (DLC)!
notes.content:
Happy New Year! Thank you for your continuous support and companionship with Journey to the West! In the spring of 2024, we will release the first DLC, in which you will meet the first pair of goddess heros - Blade Souls in the Divinity Realm!

DLC Store Page

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/0c09f7c4af995150e1d09c05207b772c0cde84c6.gif

Blade Souls is the first pair of characters with a female lead role and has a dual-soul system, allowing for switching during combats.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/3ea36016d8243c3a7556cc0d3de58b0fe27418a4.gif

Soul System: The higher the Soul power, the less energy. The Light Soul attack cards will consume, and the more energy the skill cards will consume, but they will receive additional bonuses. The Dark Soul, on the other hand, operates oppositely, with her skill cards consuming less energy and her attack cards receiving additional bonuses.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/763b215084d998d5bcdc27c35f7e5bd824cfa842.gif

New Cards

Stealding Card: Characters come equipped with theft, allowing them to steal items while inflicting damage, a win-win situation to collect all the treasures along the Journey to the West.

Stun Card: No need to rely on wetness and shock to trigger it; with the right gameplay, passing through without harm is not a problem!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/884dbb962902c0f9d6541e03b0cdcf010c4175fb.gif

Lost Card: Forcibly confuses bosses/elites, no longer only effective against small fry!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/d00b518412630c6ae703168a80cc361253c2d42f.gif

New Builds

 Combo build: Seven-comboseries, eternal life, endless flow.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/6594e823d1bb4f510f1396aa519e6eb2344b053b.gif

 Poison-Stacking build: Let's stack together (keep the spider away from me).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/1bfc767c231f777de24daeb41a067d46bffee95c.gif
 
 Invisibility build: As long as you're invisible, you'll come with a thousand souls and spirits, along with high burst damage.
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/638457ac40b834a0e3fc778d84bba27dafdbfbdc.gif
 
 Infinite build: Draw countless sub-decks.


The Blade Souls will officially released after the 2024 Chinese New Year. We look forward to players developing more gameplay. See you in the new year!

notes.title: Dev Log #083: 2023-10-27
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! Thank you for your support along this journey!

Starting from now, the Journey to the West weekly dev log will transition into monthly reports, as the official version has been released, and we will be focusing on the development of new DLC. Steam updates will still aim for a weekly schedule or every two weeks, and we will also provide regular progress reports on the DLC development.


Gameplay Optimization:


 Lv. 3 Vanquisher of Evil now gains the Hell Power ability. Add the Hell Power card to Lv. 3 Vanquisher of Evil.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/b3bedb64ab4226c597ef92bdae9840c0a66915d8.png

 Vampire's Hankerchief now increases maximum health when defeating enemies, without the need for self-attacks.
 Add player card plays and NPC intent records to the combat log, with highlighting.
 Greedy Pig trait now allows a maximum of 3/4/5 consumables per turn.


Bug Fixes:


 Fixed an issue with Endless Universe where the As-You-Like-It World continued to function during sleep and stun.
 Fixed an issue where level stars wouldn't fade out when removing cards.
 Fixed an issue with Nine-Petal Mace where it couldn't trigger in event battles.
 Fixed a bug in turn display during timed battles.
 Fixed an issue with Crystal Dice where it could trigger twice under certain circumstances.
 Corrected a typo in the explanation of Goddess of the Moon.
 Optimized the attack effects of Vermilion Bird.
 Fixed an issue with the explanation of Tang Monk's Meditation Stone.
 Fixed a bug in Tiger Knight where the Thirty-Six Transformations couldn't correctly increase attack power.
 Fixed an issue with Yang Jian where enabling it in the Pokedex had special sound effects.
 Fixed a bug where Spiritual Money resurrected with 100% HP.
 Adjusted the order of Carrot's rabbit summons to ensure that the Thief Rabbit is first.
 Various localization bug fixes.

notes.title: Dev Log #078: 2023-09-21
notes.content:
Did everyone start using the Monkey King skins that were updated last week? Does it make wielding the Monkey King Bar even more powerful? You can also try Journey to the West on iOS here in Apple Store!

This week, we continue to optimize the game, and the DLC production is also proceeding as planned! The new skins of rabbit girls are almost ready!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/cf87d4526b53b8e6d2a0c0e65e0fc7acd01d58aa.jpg

Major Optimizations

We've made several optimizations and adjustments to the Mighty Monkey and the Hairy Monkey:

 The Mighty Monkey now sports the New Monkey King skin, making it more imposing! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/4f4a089cee7161e88c128753a30a6903c6dd92df.png

 We've removed the Defensive Offence card from Mighty Monkey’s card set and improved its passive ability.
 The Mighty Monkey's passive ability has now changed to 2/3/4 Rupture, and made Rupture to be applied when target’s defense decreased, rather than when breaking the opponent's defense. This greatly enhances the utility of Rupture in multiple attacks, especially when combined with the Holy Monk and many companions, increasing the power of the Vermilion Bird.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/3cc8452c1b0dec3c29ecdc0a0986410cb9421e22.png

 We've slightly buffed the Hairy Monkey: the passive has been changed to 2/3/4 damage and defense, with the fixed card usage of 3.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/700c29655d15a684ac51a461dcb39f554535cc77.png


We've optimized the text description for the requirements of the final chapter's storyline, changing "Good" to "Virtue" and "Evil" to "Sin" to avoid confusion with the game's good and evil states.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/86ff74ebf85700e6579baa8941d1d534883ba585.png

Regarding the game's save mechanism, now, the game will not save when leaving a location until entering the next location. This is to prevent accidental actions and offer better S/L experiences. You no longer need to worry about choosing the wrong relic or grabbing the wrong card.

Now, the Seven Treasure Tree is effective against defenses other than cards.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/f9db184556a4d4b90f86862f6f453e9ff5743386.png

Other adjustments

 The Dream-Eater’sClaw will now remember the last card played for easier selection.
 The Chaotic Iron Axe will prioritize upgrading cards in the deck.
 We've adjusted the logic for the appearance of the Reincarnation Stone, which will only appear in Chapters 1 and 2 to avoid its presence in Chapters 3 and 4 without being helpful.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug where the Rose Golden Bell attached to already upgraded cards during combat would render the upgrade ineffective.
 Fixed an English text bug when Master of Heave retreated in the Tang Monk's Heavenly Palace storyline.
 Fixed the explanation of the evil state.
 Fixed a bug that caused a companion resurrection failure due to Holy Monk’s  Resurrection card.
 Fixed an abnormality caused by choosing a relic when using the last played card.

notes.title: DLC female protagonist settings！Dev Log #076: 2023-09-07
notes.content:
This week we continue to adjust game mechanics, optimize art and user experience, and fix bugs. The production and design of the new DLC is also proceeding in an orderly manner!

You can try Journey to the West on iOS here in Apple Store!

DLC female protagonist setting:
The new characters are a pair of twin sisters, sword spirits belonging to the same sword, one is the blade and the other is the scabbard.
The character will have the characteristics of one body and two souls, the light soul is focusing on attacking, and the shadow soul is focusing on skills.
Players can switch forms at any time during the battle to maximize output.
At present, the design of the new protagonist has been basically completed, and the logic implementation, animation, special effects, sound effects, plot, etc. are expected to be completed before the end of the year.

This is the first week since our full release! We have received a lot of support and love, as well as some constructive feedback! Thank you all for your support! If you enjoy our game, please recommend it to others! Every positive review and recommendation is a great encouragement for our small indie studio! 

Please continue to follow us on our official Bilibili channel or Youtube channel, and we will keep you informed of any progress!

This week, we focus on further enhancing the game experience, fixing bugs, and ensuring a stable version.

Optimizaion of The Omen

Based on your feedback, we have made some adjustments to the mechanism of the Heart Demon. In addition to being sealed through the previous elemental sealing mechanism, the Omen can now also be defeated through direct attacks. Killing the Omen once counts as one level of sealing. It is important to note that each card used will bear the corresponding effect of the Heart Demon's layers. Additionally, the Heart Demon now recovers HP at the end of the player's turn, restoring 50% in Trials 1-19 and 100% in Trial 20.

With the introduction of the new sealing machanism, it is no longer necessary to rely solely on the elements. This aims to minimize the experience of missing turns due to a lack of required elements to seal.

Now, if elites and bosses receive high overflow single-target damage, it will display how many times you have killed the target in total. The higher the damage stack, the more satisfying it is!

notes.title: A Letter for 1st Anniversary! and Dev Log #052: 2023-03-17
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I'm Dr. Z. It has been a year since the launch of Journey to the West EA. Thank you all for your continuous support, encouragement, and urging. On this special day, I want to chat with you all about the status of the project and studio, and our plans for 2023.

Journey to the West is our first commercial product at Z Studio, which consists of only 2 people. For nearly 3.5 years now, we have been pouring our hearts and souls into this game, self-funding every step of the way. We haven't taken a salary, and have even had to spend nearly RMB 2 million on outsourcing expenses. We made plenty of mistakes along the way, especially with our lack of experience in gameplay and art, which unfortunately resulted in sales not being proportionate to our effort.

But despite all of this, we've never given up. I personally have been working 14 hours a day, 7 days a week, trying to make this game the best it can be. The journey has been tough, but there's nothing more enjoyable or fulfilling to us than developing games. And even though sales have been poor, we're not going to let that discourage us. We're determined to keep improving the game so that we can bring everyone out there a high-quality, enjoyable experience.


We plan to release the official version in May. The last character, Faithful Devil, is now available for closed beta testing, while there are still balance, bug, and art improvements needed. After that, we hope to develop three or more DLCs and adjust the development period based on funding.

notes.content:
Chapter 4 is released! 

Thank you for supporting us along this difficult but fun journey, we will have a special 10% discount starting September 30th (3am PDT), 7 days only! It is a great time to buy (if you haven’t), recommend, or give our game to friends and family as a gift!

Aifadian creator page is now live! Come to join us and support our game!

We just started to test our mobile versions in preparation for future mobile releases, and we opened up a limited number of beta testing slots. Please check out our Aifadian page to try our mobile versions!

Introduction to Chapter 4

There are 3 challenging storylines in Chapter 4, each comes after different chapter 3 bosses. There are different plots and prerequisites to enter the final chapters for each hero, and each hero has a couple of different ends (currently we have 37 different ends).

Heaven is the final chapter that you can enter after defeating Divine of Justice at the end of Chapter 3. You will face the four generals guarding the Gate of Heaven in elite combat, and later face The Jade Emperor and his powerful team in the final combat. Based on your encounter before, you might be able to collaborate with both the Divine of Justice and the Fallen Monkey General to take revenge and destroy Heaven!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/73ac9fb5bcb496ba799c159aad06a897bdb92ea8.gif

Soul Mountains is the final chapter that you can enter after defeating the Fallen Phoenix at the end of Chapter 3. Based on your encounters and choices before, you will be able to collaborate with Golden Eyebrows and Fallen Phoenix, encounter the Goddess of Cruelty (Goddess of Mercy’s sister) in elite combat, confront the High Buddha, defeat the ultimate evil, and choose the true love for Holy Monk!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39003293/e8ebb097731076385356839df04b0f8d0e697a15.gif

The Plane of Eternity is the final chapter that you can enter after defeating the Hell Emperor at the end of Chapter 3. The Plane of Eternity is the home and prison of Omen - the immortal being formed by sins, pain, and hatred. The seal of five elements was broken and the Omen was partially released and started its bad influence on the world, creating war, chaos, and killings. You will help the Goddess of Mercy to rebuild the Five Elements Seal to seal the Omen, face your own desires and sins, and make the right decisions.

Conditions to enter the final chapter

Friendly to Demons: choose choice 2 in chapter 3 boss event (when the boss is Fallen Phoenix).

Moral Status: Good, Evil, or Neutral
We added a system to count how many “Good” choices and “Evil” choices you made during your journey from chapters 1-3 and will determine the character’s Moral Status when finishing up Chapter 3:
Good: Good Points > Evil Points AND Good Points >=3
Evil: Evil Points >= Good Points AND Evil Points >=3
Neutral: not Good nor Evil
How to earn Good Points? 
Earn 3 Good Points for each Hostage saved
Earn 1 Good Point when making good choices in events or encounters (e.g. help people)
How to earn Evil Points?
Earn 100 Evil Points for drinking Demon Blood (special relic)
Earn 1 Evil Point when making Evil choices in events or encounters (e.g. kill, rob, or steal  from innocent people)
You can check out your moral status by clicking on the profile picture of the hero, and we will add more guidance and in-game notification about good or evil choices.

Introducing new features

 Moral Status: Good, Evil, or Neutral

 We added a system to count how many “Good” choices and “Evil” choices you made during your journey from chapters 1-3 and will determine the character’s Moral Status when finishing up Chapter 3:

 Good: Good Points > Evil Points AND Good Points >=5
 Evil: Evil Points >= Good Points AND Evil Points >=5
 Neutral: not Good nor Evil

 How to earn Good Points? 
 Earn 5 Good Points for each Hostage saved
 Earn 1 Good Point when making good choices in events or encounters (e.g. save or help people)
 How to earn Evil Points?
 Earn 5 Evil Points for drinking Demon Blood (special relic)
 Earn 1 Evil Point when making Evil choices in events or encounters (e.g. kill, rob, or steal  from innocent people)
 You can check out your moral status by clicking on the profile picture of the hero, and we will add more guidance and in-game notification about good or evil choices.

notes.title: Dev Log #002：2022-03-22
notes.content:
This week, we opened 3 new levels of trials (17-19), added mac build, and made decent progress on optimizations, balances, and bug fixes.

Major Updates

Mac build is now available! 
Trial 17-19 now open! We will post a separate post about detailed change log for Trial 17-19, but quick overview:
 
Trial 17: Normal NPCs now have more challenging behaviors
Trial 18: Elites now have more challenging behaviors

Optimization

Performance

Add safe check to improve security for game saves

UI Improvement

Add additional info for relics
Add additional info for all Cards
Change Chinese font to Heiti
Group card by name in Journal
Optimize Black Market UI


Balance 
Game Logic

Explosion logic change: trigger all poison damage at once and  burning counts remain the same after explosion -> each burning count will trigger 5 poison, and the equal counts of burning will be removed after the explosion.

Example 1,  apply 15 poison and 2 burning together:

Before: the explosion deals  all poison damage at once: 15+14+13+12+11….+1 = 120 damage. Burning counts will remain the same after the explosion.
Now: 2 burnings will trigger 10 poison at once:10+9+ ….+1=55 damage , 2 burning will be removed after the explosion, and there is 5 poison left 
Example 2,  apply 15 poison and 5 burning together: 
Before: the explosion deals all poison damage at once: 15+14+13+12+11….+1 = 120 damage. Burning counts will remain the same after the explosion.
Now: 3 burnings will trigger 15 poison at once: 15+14+13+12+11….+1 = 120 damage. 3 burning will be removed after the explosion (2 burning left), and there is no poison left.
Base trial factor: 80% HP -> 75% HP
Change choice 2 of the “Chrysanthemum Temple” event: exchange -> transform 

Wukong

One last fight: add “Retain” keyword, Energy cost +1
